instruction: In LibreOffice Impress, disable the Presenter Console so presentations use only one monitor instead of two.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads registrymodifications.xcu, which is the persistent storage for the PresenterScreenEnabled setting in LibreOffice Impress.

Regex pattern 'PresenterScreenEnabled[^<]*<value>(false|true)</value>' correctly matches the XCU XML structure where [^<]* spans intermediate non-'<' characters (tag closing '>' and whitespace/newlines) between the attribute name and the value element.
Default behavior assumption (entry absent = presenter console enabled) is semantically correct since LibreOffice Impress enables the Presenter Console by default.
Metric correctly evaluates presenter_disabled boolean: returns 1.0 only when disabled, 0.0 otherwise.
No postconfig needed since the getter reads a config file directly, not a live UI dialog state.
Single instruction requirement (disable Presenter Console) is fully covered by a single boolean check on the correct setting.
